## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `make lint` and the tests for the touched packages pass.
- [ ] Docs: changed behavior, flags or environment variables are reflected in the relevant README or
      `docs/` page, with the right maturity label (see `docs/CONTRIBUTING-DOCS.md`).
- [ ] Docs: `make check-links` passes if any Markdown changed.
- [ ] A new spec or ADR is registered in `docs/specs/README.md` or `docs/adrs/README.md`.
